candidates.content_text:
Site / Project Engineer - Civil & Concrete
Oakleigh Civil - South Australia
Join a growing South Australian civil construction company and build your career across project engineering, construction delivery, estimating and commercial management. 
About Oakleigh Civil 
Oakleigh Civil is a South Australian civil construction company specialising in civil infrastructure and structural concrete projects. Our capabilities include formwork, reinforcement, concrete placement and excavation. 
We work with on major infrastructure projects across metropolitan and regional South Australia, as well as interstate. 
Our work spans water infrastructure, defence, renewable energy, roads, mining and electrical infrastructure. 
Our experienced team takes a practical approach to delivering projects safely and to a very high standard. We value strong client relationships and take pride in being a contractor our clients can rely on.
About the role 
We are seeking a motivated Site / Project Engineer with at least three years’ construction experience to join our growing team. 
Working closely with the Construction Manager, company management, site supervisors and clients, you will help plan, coordinate and deliver projects from tender stage through to completion.  
The role combines site-based project management, estimating and commercial responsibilities. Unlike a traditional site engineering role, you will have exposure to the full project lifecycle, including estimating, procurement, construction delivery, cost control, variations, progress claims and project close-out. 
The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership of assigned projects, identify issues early and work with the project team to develop practical solutions. 
This position suits someone who is looking to broaden their capabilities, take greater responsibility and develop their career within a growing civil construction business.
Key responsibilities 
- Plan and coordinate construction activities with site supervisors to meet project requirements and construction programs. 
- Take ownership of allocated projects from planning through to completion. 
- Maintain regular communication with clients regarding project progress, upcoming works and any issues requiring resolution. 
- Review drawings, specifications and scope documents, identify issues, discrepancies, risks and constructability issues. 
- Assist with estimating, quantity take-offs, quotations and tender submissions. 
- Prepare and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts and progress reports. 
- Monitor project costs, cost-to-complete and forecasts. 
- Prepare and track project costs, variations and progress claims. 
- Coordinate procurement of materials, subcontractors and suppliers in accordance with project requirements and programs. 
- Coordinate project quality requirements, including ITP’s, inspections, testing, NCR’s and handover documentation. 
- Maintain accurate project documentation, registers, correspondence and records. 
- Support site safety requirements and work with supervisors to ensure works are planned and delivered safely. 
- Provide practical engineering and constructability advice to site teams. 
- Build and maintain effective relationships with clients, contractors and suppliers. 
About you 
- A degree in Civil Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline. 
- At least three years’ experience as a Site or Project Engineer in construction. 
- Experience in civil infrastructure or structural concrete works; formwork, reinforcement and concrete placement experience will be highly regarded. 
- Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications and technical requirements. 
- Understanding of construction programming, project cost control, quality assurance and WHS requirements. 
- Strong organisation, communication and problem-solving skills. 
- Experience with variations, progress claims and project documentation. 
- Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects. 
- A practical approach, initiative and willingness to work closely with site supervisors and site crews. 
- Ability to identify problems early and take ownership of finding practical solutions. 
- Willingness and ability to work away from home when required. 
- A genuine desire to develop your skills and progress your career within a growing construction business. 
Why Join Oakleigh Civil?
- Varied projects: Work on civil infrastructure and structural concrete projects in metropolitan and regional South Australia, as well as interstate. 
- Broader experience: Gain exposure to the full project lifecycle, including estimating, procurement, construction, commercial management and project close out. 
- Direct involvement: Work closely with Construction Manager, company management and experienced site teams with the opportunity to influence how projects are delivered. 
- Career development: Build your capabilities across project management, estimating and commercial management, with genuine pathway to increase responsibility as the company grows. 
- Make a Contribution: Bring your ideas and help improve the way we work that supports Oakleigh Civil’s continued growth. 
Apply now 
If you’re looking to take the next step in your engineering career with Oakleigh Civil, apply through SEEK with your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

candidates.content_text:
Junior Draftsperson / Estimator
Location: Forrestdale, WA
Position: Full-time
About the Role
Dynamic Steelform is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Draftsperson / Estimator to join our growing Steel Framing team in Forrestdale.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is starting their career in drafting, estimating or construction and would like to develop practical skills within the steel fabrication and construction industry.
You will work closely with our experienced team and receive training and support to develop your knowledge of steel framing, estimating, drafting and construction processes.
Key Responsibilities
- Prepare and update technical drawings and construction documentation using CAD software
- Assist with preparing project estimates, including material quantities, labour and costs
- Read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings
- Assist with material takeoffs for steel framing and other construction materials
- Review project drawings, specifications and other documents to identify project requirements
- Work with project managers, engineers and other team members to obtain information required for drafting and estimating
- Maintain estimating information, project records and documentation
- Assist with site visits, measurements and inspections when required
- Prepare and update estimating templates and documentation
- Check drawings, quantities and estimates for accuracy and completeness
- Assist the team in identifying practical and cost-effective solutions
- Learn and develop knowledge of steel framing, construction methods, materials and estimating processes
What We're Looking For
- A qualification or relevant study in drafting, estimating, construction or a related field is preferred
- Basic to intermediate knowledge of CAD software, particularly AutoCAD or similar
- Good understanding of mathematics and attention to detail
- Ability to read and understand architectural and engineering drawings
- Good computer skills, including Microsoft Excel and Word
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Organised and able to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
- A willingness to learn and develop technical skills
- A practical and positive approach to problem-solving
- Construction, steel fabrication or manufacturing experience would be an advantage
- Previous experience with estimating software or project management systems would be an advantage, but is not essential
Full training will be provided for the right candidate.
We are happy to consider applicants who have recently completed their studies or have limited industry experience but demonstrate a strong willingness to learn.
What We Offer
At Dynamic Steelform, we are committed to providing a supportive and practical working environment where you can develop your skills and build a long-term career.
We offer:
- Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience
- On-the-job training and ongoing technical development
- The opportunity to gain practical experience in steel framing, drafting and estimating
- Training and support from experienced team members
- Opportunities for career progression as your skills develop
- A safe, friendly and respectful workplace
- A stable position within an established Western Australian company
- The opportunity to work with modern machinery, technology and construction systems
- A workplace that values teamwork, reliability and continuous improvement
About Dynamic Steelform
Dynamic Steelform is a Western Australian company specialising in steel fabrication and construction solutions.
Based in Forrestdale, we manufacture and supply steel framing and a range of steel building products for residential, commercial and construction projects.
Our business combines drafting, estimating, manufacturing and construction, giving our team members the opportunity to gain practical experience across different areas of the industry.
We are a growing and established business that values quality, reliability, teamwork and continuous improvement. We are committed to developing our people and providing opportunities for employees who want to build a long-term career in the construction and steel industry.
Apply Now
If you are interested in drafting, estimating or the construction industry and are looking for an opportunity to develop your skills, we would like to hear from you.
Please submit your resume and a short cover letter explaining your experience and why you are interested in the position.
Portfolio or examples of drafting work can also be provided if available.
We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming the right person to our team in Forrestdale.
